azure.review.storage.selected_source_sec.description: Inspect explicitly selected Azure Blob/File source objects, using coherent current reads or an optional native version/snapshot and both offline detectors.
azure.review.storage.selected_source_sec.fail_observation: A likely secret was detected in the selected stored source. Its value is hidden; offline detection did not validate it.
azure.review.storage.selected_source_sec.missing_observation: Selected stored source content was unavailable, unbound, unsupported or incompletely inspected. A clean result cannot be established.
azure.review.storage.selected_source_sec.pass_observation: Both offline detectors completed without detecting a supported secret in the selected stored source object. Coverage is limited to the captured supported text files.
azure.review.storage.selected_source_sec.purpose: Exact selected coherent current Blob/File objects or optional native Blob versions/File share snapshots. No SCM downloads, deployment/runtime identity, execution, credential validation or referenced-content proof.
azure.review.storage.selected_source_sec.remediation: Remove exposed literals from the selected stored source and rotate confirmed exposed credentials. Use managed identities or supported secret references.
azure.review.storage.selected_source_sec.title: Selected Azure stored source objects have no detected secrets
